topic: TSMC CoWoS capacity expected at end-2026 (2026 vintage estimates)
disagreement: 2026-vintage estimates of TSMC's end-2026 CoWoS capacity range from 115,000 (April low end) to 140,000 wafers/month; Economic Daily News (Sept) uses ~130,000. UBS's 160,000 industry total with 40,000 at ASE+Amkor implies ~120,000 at TSMC.
possible_reasons: population: whether OSAT-outsourced CoW/oS capacity is counted in 'TSMC capacity'
definition: installed vs exit-rate capacity, and wafer-equivalent conversion for CoWoS-L/R
source: unnamed institutional investors; methods not disclosed
rationale: All are anonymous sell-side or press estimates with no stated basis; TSMC discloses none (CLM-0799).
remaining_uncertainty: Actual end-2026 TSMC CoWoS exit capacity; plausibly 120,000-140,000 wafers/month on a TSMC-only basis.

disagreement: UBS puts ASE and Amkor at 20,000 wafers/month each at end-2026 (40,000 total); EDN (June 2026) says OSAT partners add 50,000-60,000; Dec 2025 report put ASE alone at 20,000-25,000.
possible_reasons: population: whether only full-process lines or also oS-only capacity are counted
EDN counts 'new capacity' added by OSATs, UBS reports installed totals
rationale: Different bases (added vs installed; process steps counted) and no disclosed methods.
remaining_uncertainty: OSAT share of CoWoS-class capacity on a consistent full-process basis.
